verdict.rationale: Highnote's agentic-commerce docs explicitly describe issuing per-agent cards via API with automatic card closure, velocity/MCC spend controls enforced at authorization, and a unified ledger for real-time balance/transaction visibility, all exposed through its GraphQL API (docs-17,18,19,20,42). However, there is no mention of an MCP surface, and no explicit documentation of scoped/limited API credentials for agent use (e.g., per-agent API keys or token scoping). missing for 10: MCP server/tooling evidence, explicit scoped-credential/API-key-per-agent mechanism, and third-party corroboration of agent-driven usage.
